latestVersion.changelog:
pywayne-helper v0.1.0 – Initial release

- Provides centralized YAML config file management for parameter sharing across processes and files.
- Supports automatic project root detection for configuration placement.
- Offers methods for setting, getting (with optional waiting), and deleting nested config values.
- Includes process synchronization features: one process can wait for values set by another.
- Configuration file and root detection are automatic, with easy customization options.
